say:1:1536106501:1.text: Nah, I just go by feel. If it looks right, it's good to go.
say:1:1536106501:1.source_cn: 那是啥啊？看着差不多就行了。

say:2:1536106502:1.text: I toss in fresh herbs I picked, stew 'em with some prime meat, give it a good stir. You'll smell it before you see it!
say:2:1536106502:1.source_cn: 俺把自己采的药草和鲜肉放一起熬，这样那样搅一搅，保证香！

say:2:1536106502:1.female: I toss in fresh herbs I picked, stew 'em with some prime meat, give it a good stir. You'll smell it before you see it!

say:3:1536106503:1.text: Wouldn't have bagged such fresh game without the Hunting Goddess' blessing. She's been good to us!
say:3:1536106503:1.source_cn: 多亏狩猎神的加护，俺才能猎到这么新鲜的肉！
